<thought>Using the ESI mass spectrum, the most intense ion is at m/z 182.073 which corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the proton mass gives a neutral mass of ≈181.066 Da. The formula C₉H₁₁NO₃ has an exact monoisotopic mass of 181.0739 Da (neutral) and 182.0812 Da as [M+H]⁺, matching the observed ion within experimental error and providing a reasonable isotopic pattern. Therefore the molecular formula is C9H11NO3.</thought>
<final_answer>C9H11NO3</final_answer>
